title: Ijwi mu musenyi wa kera
intro: Mu ntumwa za mbere za Allah, hari umwe izina rye rigaragara igihe gito ariko rifite icyo rivuze muri Korowani. Uyu muntu yabayeho kera cyane mbere yuko abahanuzi benshi bakomeye boherezwa, kandi yari azwiho kuba umunyakuri no kwihangana bidasubirwaho. Inkuru ye ni ngufi ariko umurage wabo uhoraho iteka ryose. Ni nde uyu mutima mwiza?
clues: Ndi umwe mu ntumwa za mbere, zivugwa muri Korowani mu buryo bugufi ariko bufite icyo buvuze.
Imiterere yanjye yagaragajwe no kwiyemeza ukuri mu buryo buhamye.
Ndibukwa mu gitabo cya Allah ndi mu bantu bari bashikamye kandi bihanganye.
Imirongo mike migufi muri Korowani ivuga inkuru yanjye.
Allah yanyubashye mu buryo budasanzwe, butari ubwo abandi bahanuzi basangira.
Nazamuwe mu mwanya wo hejuru, icyubahiro cyihariye muri Korowani.

trial.label: Igihe cyo gusobanura
options: Nazamuwe mu mwanya wo hejuru na Allah
Nubatse ubwato bunini kugira ngo nkize abantu banjye
Nabuze amaso kubera agahinda ntewe n'umuhungu wanjye
trial.answer: Nazamuwe mu mwanya wo hejuru na Allah

outcome.label: Icyubahiro cy'Imana
options: Umuragwa wo mu myaka yanjye y'ubusaza

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
